{{Quote|We make our egg salad fresh daily with hard-boiled Grade Aurek gartro eggs, tangy emulsauce, Boontaspiced mustard, taba leaves, Serrian salt and black hole pepper. Served on toasted or therm-zapped pseudograin bread.|Dex's Diner menu, on the Shawda Clubb sandwich|<ref name="Menu" />}}
'''Gartro egg salad sandwich''' was a type of [[Sandwich/Legends|sandwich]] sold at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for 5.5 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. It consisted of hard-boiled [[Grade Aurek]] [[gartro egg]]s, tangy [[Emulsauce/Legends|emulsauce]], [[Boontaspiced mustard]], [[Taba/Legends|Taba leaves]], [[Serrian salt]] and [[black hole pepper]] all on either a toasted or therm-zapped piece of [[Pseudograin bread]]. The [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] served the sandwich as part of its [[Foodstuff/Legends|lunch]] favorites<ref name="Menu" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> 

==Behind the scenes==
Gartro egg salad sandwiches were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
